config.title: Bifrost Meter
description: Shows the remaining budget and rate limits of a Bifrost virtual key in the status bar. Unofficial, not affiliated with Maxim AI.
mcp.provider.label: Bifrost Meter budget status
setting.allowInsecureHttp: Allow plain http to hosts outside loopback and private networks. The key is then sent unencrypted.
setting.baseUrl: Address of the Bifrost gateway. When not set, the BIFROST_BASE_URL environment variable is used.
setting.forecast.windowMinutes: Minutes of recent usage the run-out forecast is based on.
setting.language: Language of the meter. auto follows the editor language.
setting.notifications.enabled: Show a notification once per threshold per reset cycle, and when the forecast says a limit runs out before it resets.
setting.pollIntervalSeconds: Seconds between refreshes (at least 15). Slower after errors and while the window is not focused.
setting.statusBar.format: Status bar text: full (percent, remaining, reset), compact (percent and remaining) or percent.
setting.statusBar.metric: Which limit the status bar shows. auto shows the one closest to running out.
setting.thresholds.critical: Percent used at which the status bar turns to the error colour and a notification is shown.
setting.thresholds.warn: Percent used at which the status bar turns to the warning colour and a notification is shown.
